note: The Annex 7 Class B diesel pool mock-up. Section 5.3.1 sets the minimum size at 50 MW; section 5.3.2 the geometry: 'Width: minimum 2,5 m / Length: minimum 6,5 m', the pool 'placed on the road level so that the maximum height of the pool is 0,5m above it', and 'The minimum size for one pool is 4 m2'. The seven 4.0 m2 pools are laid across the tunnel rather than along it -- each 1.6 m of chainage by 2.5 m of width -- so the mock-up is 11.2 x 2.5 m and clears the 2.5 m width minimum. Per-pool area, total wetted area (28 m2) and therefore the design HRR are unchanged by that re-orientation; only the aspect ratio moves. lane_centre_offset_from_wall_m follows section 5.3.3, whose wording is identical to 5.2.3 and whose Figure 13 measures 'max 1.5m' from the near face of the mock-up to the tunnel wall: 2.5 - 2.5/2 = 1.25 m of wall clearance.
